title: Abhirami Andhadhi

sources.label: sivaya.org (Thirumurai Group)
sources.note: Tamil text sourced from here, per the source file. Transliteration is ISO 15919.

translation.note: The English meanings on this page were prepared for PaddySpeaks; the source files do not record a separate translator or edition for them.

verification.method: Automated consistency check: the word-by-word interpretation layer must reproduce every word of the committed Tamil text, and every Lalitha Sahasranama cross-link must resolve.
verification.scope: internal consistency — it does not re-check the Tamil against sivaya.org

knownIssues.summary: The inherited English meanings are misaligned with the Tamil for a substantial number of verses (for example verses 10, 12, 24, 25, 54 and 100). The 17 interpreted verses carry corrected renderings built from their word breakdowns; every other verse is labelled 'Working translation — under review' on the page.
